FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DeepSeaROV_6DOF_ThrusterAllocation
(* ====================================================================================================
   CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS ENGINEERING & MARITIME AUTOMATION BENCHMARK
   APPLICATION: 6-DOF DYNAMIC POSITIONING (DP-3) THRUSTER ALLOCATION & OCEAN CURRENT OBSERVER
   TARGET VEHICLE: 3500-KG DEEP-SEA HEAVY WORK-CLASS REMOTELY OPERATED VEHICLE (WROV, 4000M RATING)
   STANDARDS: IEC 61131-3 (EDITION 3), IMO MSC/CIRC.645 (DP CLASS 3), DNV-GL-ST-E272
   DESIGN PRINCIPLES:
     1. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) TMR VOTING ON ALL CRITICAL NAVIGATION SENSORS
     2. NONLINEAR DISTURBANCE OBSERVER (NDOB) FOR PERSISTENT OCEAN BOTTOM CURRENTS & TETHER DYNAMICS
     3. 8-CHANNEL PSEUDO-INVERSE THRUSTER ALLOCATION MATRIX WITH AUTOMATED FAULT REDISTRIBUTION
     4. POWER SHEDDING AUTO-THROTTLE TO PREVENT HIGH-VOLTAGE UMBILICAL BUS BLACKOUT
     5. RATE-OF-CHANGE SLEW LIMITING TO PROTECT HYDRAULIC VALVE PACKS AND BRUSHLESS DC STATORS
   ==================================================================================================== *)

VAR_INPUT
    (* Master Supervisory & Safety Inputs *)
    bEnableMasterDP         : BOOL;             (* Master DP-3 System Enable Signal [TRUE=Run, FALSE=Standby] *)
    bEmergencyStopCircuit   : BOOL;             (* Umbilical Hardwired Safety Interlock Loop [Active Low / TRUE=Normal] *)
    bAcknowledgeFaults      : BOOL;             (* Manual Operator Trip Reset and Latch Clear Command *)
    tDiscreteScanCycle      : TIME := T#20MS;   (* PLC Cyclic Scan Task Interval [ms] *)

    (* Desired 6-DOF Dynamic Positioning Setpoints [m], [deg] *)
    rRef_Surge_Pos_m        : REAL;             (* Target Station-Keeping Surge Position X_ned [m] *)
    rRef_Sway_Pos_m         : REAL;             (* Target Station-Keeping Sway Position Y_ned [m] *)
    rRef_Depth_Pos_m        : REAL;             (* Target Subsea Station-Keeping Depth Z_ned [m] *)
    rRef_Heading_deg        : REAL;             (* Commanded True Gyro Heading Target psi_ref [0.0 .. 359.9 deg] *)
    rRef_TrimRoll_deg       : REAL;             (* Commanded Vehicle Trim Angle Roll phi_ref [-15.0 .. +15.0 deg] *)
    rRef_TrimPitch_deg      : REAL;             (* Commanded Vehicle Trim Angle Pitch theta_ref [-15.0 .. +15.0 deg] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Acoustic Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel A Surge Body Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel B Surge Body Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel C Surge Body Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChA_mps   : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel A Sway Body Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChB_mps   : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel B Sway Body Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChC_mps   : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel C Sway Body Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChA_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel A Heave Body Velocity w [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChB_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel B Heave Body Velocity w [m/s] *)
    rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChC_mps  : REAL;             (* DVL Transceiver Channel C Heave Body Velocity w [m/s] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Fiber Optic Gyroscope (FOG-INS) Angular Rates [rad/s] *)
    rINS_RollRate_ChA_rads  : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel A Body Roll Angular Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rINS_RollRate_ChB_rads  : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel B Body Roll Angular Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rINS_RollRate_ChC_rads  : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel C Body Roll Angular Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rINS_PitchRate_ChA_rads : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel A Body Pitch Angular Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rINS_PitchRate_ChB_rads : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel B Body Pitch Angular Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rINS_PitchRate_ChC_rads : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel C Body Pitch Angular Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rINS_YawRate_ChA_rads   : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel A Body Yaw Angular Rate r [rad/s] *)
    rINS_YawRate_ChB_rads   : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel B Body Yaw Angular Rate r [rad/s] *)
    rINS_YawRate_ChC_rads   : REAL;             (* FOG-INS Channel C Body Yaw Angular Rate r [rad/s] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Subsea Hydrostatic Depth Cells [m] *)
    rDepth_Sensor_ChA_m     : REAL;             (* Digiquartz Depth Transducer Channel A Reading [m] *)
    rDepth_Sensor_ChB_m     : REAL;             (* Digiquartz Depth Transducer Channel B Reading [m] *)
    rDepth_Sensor_ChC_m     : REAL;             (* Digiquartz Depth Transducer Channel C Reading [m] *)

    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Gyrocompass Heading [deg] *)
    rINS_Heading_ChA_deg    : REAL;             (* Marine FOG Gyrocompass Heading Channel A [deg] *)
    rINS_Heading_ChB_deg    : REAL;             (* Marine FOG Gyrocompass Heading Channel B [deg] *)
    rINS_Heading_ChC_deg    : REAL;             (* Marine FOG Gyrocompass Heading Channel C [deg] *)

    (* Thruster Hardware Status & Power Allocation Interface *)
    wThrusterHealthRegister : WORD;             (* 8-Bit Health Mask (Bit 0=T1 .. Bit 7=T8) [1=Healthy, 0=Tripped] *)
    rBollardThrustRating_N  : REAL := 6800.0;   (* Maximum Continuous Bollard Pull Force Rating per Thruster [N] *)
    rMaxBusPowerAvailable_kW: REAL := 180.0;    (* Subsea Power Distribution System Peak Power Limit [kW] *)
    rPowerConversionConstant: REAL := 0.026;    (* Thruster Power Conversion Factor [kW / (N^1.5)] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* Primary System Status Words and Annunciators *)
    bSystemOperational      : BOOL;             (* DP-3 Station-Keeping Loop Fully Active and Within Deadband *)
    bDegradedOperation      : BOOL;             (* System Operating with Redundancy Loss (Thruster or Sensor Fail) *)
    bSafetyTripActive       : BOOL;             (* Critical Safety Trip or Total Loss of Station-Keeping *)
    wMasterStatusWord       : WORD;             (* Comprehensive System Diagnostic Status Bitfield *)
    wSensorHealthMatrix     : WORD;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Fault & Discrepancy Bitfield *)

    (* Demanded 6-DOF Generalized Control Wrench [N], [Nm] *)
    rDemandedWrench_X_N     : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Force in Surge Axis tau_X [N] *)
    rDemandedWrench_Y_N     : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Force in Sway Axis tau_Y [N] *)
    rDemandedWrench_Z_N     : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Force in Heave Axis tau_Z [N] *)
    rDemandedTorque_K_Nm    : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Torque in Roll Axis tau_K [Nm] *)
    rDemandedTorque_M_Nm    : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Torque in Pitch Axis tau_M [Nm] *)
    rDemandedTorque_N_Nm    : REAL;             (* Commanded Net Torque in Yaw Axis tau_N [Nm] *)

    (* Nonlinear Disturbance Observer (NDOB) Current & Hydrodynamic Disturbance Estimates *)
    rEstDisturbance_Surge_N : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Current Environmental Force in Surge [N] *)
    rEstDisturbance_Sway_N  : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Current Environmental Force in Sway [N] *)
    rEstDisturbance_Heave_N : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Upwelling / Tether Umbilical Pull in Heave [N] *)
    rEstDisturbance_Yaw_Nm  : REAL;             (* Observed Ocean Current Induced Hydrodynamic Yaw Torque [Nm] *)
    rEstOceanCurrentVel_mps : REAL;             (* Inferred Ambient Deep-Sea Current Velocity Magnitude [m/s] *)

    (* Individual 8-Thruster Setpoint Command Outputs [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH: REAL;             (* T1: Forward-Starboard Horizontal Thruster (45 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH: REAL;             (* T2: Forward-Port Horizontal Thruster (135 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH: REAL;             (* T3: Aft-Port Horizontal Thruster (225 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH: REAL;             (* T4: Aft-Starboard Horizontal Thruster (315 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV: REAL;             (* T5: Forward-Starboard Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV: REAL;             (* T6: Forward-Port Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV: REAL;             (* T7: Aft-Port Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)
    rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV: REAL;             (* T8: Aft-Starboard Vertical Thruster (Canted 15 deg) [N] *)

    (* Subsea Power & Actuator Envelope Diagnostics *)
    rAggregatedPower_kW     : REAL;             (* Total Electrical/Hydraulic Grid Load Estimate [kW] *)
    rPowerAttenuationRatio  : REAL;             (* Active Grid Load-Shedding Attenuation Factor [0.0 .. 1.0] *)
    bThrustSaturationActive : BOOL;             (* Hardware Saturation Flag (At Least One Thruster at Rating) *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* Supervisory Finite State Machine State Pointer *)
    iOperatingMode          : INT := 0;         (* Operating State: 0=ColdInit, 10=Standby, 20=DP3_Full, 30=Degraded, 99=Failsafe *)
    iActiveSubPhase         : INT := 0;         (* Multi-Stage Sequential Phase Indicator *)

    (* Hydrodynamic Model State Space Parameters (WROV Rigid Body + Added Mass) *)
    rMassTotal_kg           : REAL := 3780.0;   (* Total In-Water ROV Mass [kg] *)
    rAddedMass_X_kg         : REAL := 1980.0;   (* Surge Added Mass Tensor Component X_udot [kg] *)
    rAddedMass_Y_kg         : REAL := 2520.0;   (* Sway Added Mass Tensor Component Y_vdot [kg] *)
    rAddedMass_Z_kg         : REAL := 3250.0;   (* Heave Added Mass Tensor Component Z_wdot [kg] *)
    rInertia_Z_kgm2         : REAL := 4450.0;   (* Yaw Mass Moment of Inertia I_zz + N_rdot [kg*m^2] *)

    (* Hydrodynamic Damping Parameters (Linear Skin Friction + Quadratic Crossflow Form Drag) *)
    rDampLin_Surge          : REAL := 240.0;    (* Surge Linear Damping [N*s/m] *)
    rDampQuad_Surge         : REAL := 510.0;    (* Surge Quadratic Damping [N*s^2/m^2] *)
    rDampLin_Sway           : REAL := 360.0;    (* Sway Linear Damping [N*s/m] *)
    rDampQuad_Sway          : REAL := 680.0;    (* Sway Quadratic Damping [N*s^2/m^2] *)
    rDampLin_Heave          : REAL := 440.0;    (* Heave Linear Damping [N*s/m] *)
    rDampQuad_Heave         : REAL := 820.0;    (* Heave Quadratic Damping [N*s^2/m^2] *)
    rDampLin_Yaw            : REAL := 720.0;    (* Yaw Linear Damping [Nm*s/rad] *)
    rDampQuad_Yaw           : REAL := 1380.0;   (* Yaw Quadratic Damping [Nm*s^2/rad^2] *)

    (* Nonlinear Disturbance Observer (NDOB) Internal Continuous-Discrete Registers *)
    rDOB_State_z_Surge      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Surge [N] *)
    rDOB_State_z_Sway       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Sway [N] *)
    rDOB_State_z_Heave      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Heave [N] *)
    rDOB_State_z_Yaw        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filter State Variable z_Yaw [Nm] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Surge         : REAL := 2.10;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_surge [rad/s] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Sway          : REAL := 2.10;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_sway [rad/s] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Heave         : REAL := 1.65;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_heave [rad/s] *)
    rDOB_Gain_Yaw           : REAL := 2.45;     (* Observer Bandwidth Convergence Gain L_yaw [rad/s] *)

    (* 2oo3 TMR Validated Navigation Telemetry Registers *)
    rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Surge Velocity u [m/s] *)
    rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Sway Velocity v [m/s] *)
    rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Heave Velocity w [m/s] *)
    rVoted_RollRate_rads    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Roll Rate p [rad/s] *)
    rVoted_PitchRate_rads   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Pitch Rate q [rad/s] *)
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Body Yaw Rate r [rad/s] *)
    rVoted_Depth_m          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Hydrostatic Depth [m] *)
    rVoted_Heading_deg      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Triply-Voted Gyro Heading [deg] *)

    (* Dead-Reckoning Position Accumulators [m] *)
    rEstimatedPos_Surge_m   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Integrated Dead-Reckoning Surge Coordinate [m] *)
    rEstimatedPos_Sway_m    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Integrated Dead-Reckoning Sway Coordinate [m] *)

    (* Closed-Loop Tracking Errors *)
    rErr_Surge_m            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position Error in Surge Axis [m] *)
    rErr_Sway_m             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position Error in Sway Axis [m] *)
    rErr_Depth_m            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Position Error in Heave Axis [m] *)
    rErr_Heading_deg        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Angular Heading Tracking Error [-180.0 .. +180.0 deg] *)

    (* PID Control Integral Accumulators with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    rInteg_Surge_Ns         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Surge Axis Integrator Accumulator [N*s] *)
    rInteg_Sway_Ns          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Sway Axis Integrator Accumulator [N*s] *)
    rInteg_Depth_Ns         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Heave Axis Integrator Accumulator [N*s] *)
    rInteg_Yaw_Nms          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Yaw Axis Integrator Accumulator [Nm*s] *)

    (* PID Gain Parameter Tuning Constants *)
    rKp_Surge               : REAL := 4800.0;   (* Proportional Gain Surge [N/m] *)
    rKi_Surge               : REAL := 310.0;    (* Integral Gain Surge [N/(m*s)] *)
    rKd_Surge               : REAL := 7600.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Surge [N*s/m] *)

    rKp_Sway                : REAL := 4500.0;   (* Proportional Gain Sway [N/m] *)
    rKi_Sway                : REAL := 280.0;    (* Integral Gain Sway [N/(m*s)] *)
    rKd_Sway                : REAL := 7100.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Sway [N*s/m] *)

    rKp_Depth               : REAL := 5900.0;   (* Proportional Gain Heave [N/m] *)
    rKi_Depth               : REAL := 420.0;    (* Integral Gain Heave [N/(m*s)] *)
    rKd_Depth               : REAL := 8900.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Heave [N*s/m] *)

    rKp_Yaw                 : REAL := 6600.0;   (* Proportional Gain Yaw [Nm/rad] *)
    rKi_Yaw                 : REAL := 350.0;    (* Integral Gain Yaw [Nm/(rad*s)] *)
    rKd_Yaw                 : REAL := 9800.0;   (* Derivative Damping Gain Yaw [Nm*s/rad] *)

    (* Thruster Dynamic Force Arrays *)
    arrUnboundedThrust_N    : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Unconstrained Force Allocation Vector u_raw [N] *)
    arrConditionedThrust_N  : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Allocated Thrust After Power and Slew Conditioning [N] *)
    arrPreviousThrustCmd_N  : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL; (* Historical Output Array for Slew Rate Limiting [N] *)

    (* Physical Configuration Geometry Constants *)
    rInvSqrt2               : REAL := 0.70710678; (* 1 / SQRT(2) = sin(45 deg) = cos(45 deg) *)
    rCantedCos15            : REAL := 0.96592583; (* cos(15 deg) vertical thruster inclination factor *)
    rCantedSin15            : REAL := 0.25881905; (* sin(15 deg) lateral thruster cross-coupling factor *)
    rMomentArm_X_m          : REAL := 1.05;       (* Longitudinal Distance to Thruster Centerlines [m] *)
    rMomentArm_Y_m          : REAL := 0.88;       (* Transverse Distance to Thruster Centerlines [m] *)

    (* Timers and Safety Enunciators *)
    tonWatchdogHeartbeat    : TON;              (* Supervisory Communication Loss Watchdog *)
    tonDegradedDebounce     : TON;              (* Degraded Mode State Confirmation Filter *)
    tonTripHold             : TON;              (* Safety Trip Acknowledgment Lockout Timer *)

    (* Internal Computation Auxiliaries *)
    rCycleTime_s            : REAL;             (* Cyclic Task Delta Time [s] *)
    rInternalHydroForce     : REAL;             (* Instantaneous Model Hydrodynamic Force [N] *)
    rCurrentPowerSum_kW     : REAL;             (* Instantaneous Aggregated Thruster Power [kW] *)
    iIdx                    : INT;              (* General Loop Iterator *)
    iVertLoop               : INT;              (* Vertical Redundancy Loop Index *)
    rDiff_AB                : REAL;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Channel Comparison AB *)
    rDiff_BC                : REAL;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Channel Comparison BC *)
    rDiff_CA                : REAL;             (* 2oo3 Sensor Channel Comparison CA *)
    rSlewLimit_Nps          : REAL := 2800.0;   (* Maximum Actuator Slew Rate [N/s] *)
    iHealthyCount           : INT := 8;         (* Count of Currently Available Thrusters *)
END_VAR

(* ====================================================================================================
   CONTROL EXECUTION ENGINE
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* --- SAFETY INTERLOCK STAGE 0: HARDWIRED EMERGENCY STOP & ELECTRICAL TRIP --- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStopCircuit THEN
    (* Immediate De-energization of All Eight Thrusters *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;

    rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV := 0.0;
    rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV := 0.0;

    rDemandedWrench_X_N  := 0.0;
    rDemandedWrench_Y_N  := 0.0;
    rDemandedWrench_Z_N  := 0.0;
    rDemandedTorque_K_Nm := 0.0;
    rDemandedTorque_M_Nm := 0.0;
    rDemandedTorque_N_Nm := 0.0;

    bSystemOperational    := FALSE;
    bSafetyTripActive     := TRUE;
    wMasterStatusWord     := 16#F001; (* Status Flag: Emergency Circuit Open *)
    iOperatingMode        := 99;      (* Shift FSM to Failsafe State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Convert System Task Interval to Seconds for Integration *)
rCycleTime_s := TIME_TO_REAL(tDiscreteScanCycle) / 1000.0;
IF rCycleTime_s < 0.002 THEN
    rCycleTime_s := 0.020; (* Clamp to Standard 20ms Task Cycle *)
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iOperatingMode OF)
   ==================================================================================================== *)
CASE iOperatingMode OF

    0: (* =========================================================================
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & SENSOR SELF-TEST
          ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemOperational      := FALSE;
        bDegradedOperation      := FALSE;
        bSafetyTripActive       := FALSE;
        bThrustSaturationActive := FALSE;
        wMasterStatusWord       := 16#0001; (* Initialization Active *)
        wSensorHealthMatrix     := 16#0000;

        (* Reset Integral Terms *)
        rInteg_Surge_Ns := 0.0;
        rInteg_Sway_Ns  := 0.0;
        rInteg_Depth_Ns := 0.0;
        rInteg_Yaw_Nms  := 0.0;

        (* Initialize NDOB State Registers *)
        rDOB_State_z_Surge := 0.0;
        rDOB_State_z_Sway  := 0.0;
        rDOB_State_z_Heave := 0.0;
        rDOB_State_z_Yaw   := 0.0;

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx]   := 0.0;
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;

        IF bEnableMasterDP THEN
            iOperatingMode := 20; (* Transition directly into DP-3 Active Mode *)
        ELSE
            iOperatingMode := 10; (* Transition to Standby Ready *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* =========================================================================
           STATE 10: STANDBY READY (SYSTEM ENERGIZED BUT THRUSTERS AT NEUTRAL)
           ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemOperational := FALSE;
        bSafetyTripActive  := FALSE;
        wMasterStatusWord  := 16#0010; (* Standby Mode *)

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;

        rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV := 0.0;

        IF bEnableMasterDP THEN
            (* Operator engaged DP: Synchronize initial setpoints to current position *)
            rEstimatedPos_Surge_m := 0.0;
            rEstimatedPos_Sway_m  := 0.0;
            iOperatingMode        := 20; (* Enter Active Closed-Loop DP *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* =========================================================================
           STATE 20: FULL DP-3 6-DOF CLOSED-LOOP STATION KEEPING
           ========================================================================= *)
        wMasterStatusWord := 16#0020; (* Nominal DP-3 Mode Active *)

        (* --- SUB-PHASE 1: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) TMR SENSOR VOTING --- *)
        (* Surge Velocity 2oo3 Voting *)
        rDiff_AB := ABS(rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps - rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps);
        rDiff_BC := ABS(rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps - rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps);
        rDiff_CA := ABS(rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps - rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps);

        IF (rDiff_AB <= 0.18) AND (rDiff_CA <= 0.18) THEN
            rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps + rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps + rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps) / 3.0;
        ELSIF (rDiff_AB <= 0.18) THEN
            rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps + rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
            wSensorHealthMatrix  := wSensorHealthMatrix OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: DVL Ch C Divergence *)
        ELSIF (rDiff_BC <= 0.18) THEN
            rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps + rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps) * 0.5;
            wSensorHealthMatrix  := wSensorHealthMatrix OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: DVL Ch A Divergence *)
        ELSIF (rDiff_CA <= 0.18) THEN
            rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps + rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps) * 0.5;
            wSensorHealthMatrix  := wSensorHealthMatrix OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: DVL Ch B Divergence *)
        ELSE
            (* Disagreement fallback: select median *)
            IF ((rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps) AND (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps)) OR
               ((rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps) AND (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps)) THEN
                rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps;
            ELSIF ((rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps) AND (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps)) OR
                  ((rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChA_mps) AND (rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps)) THEN
                rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChB_mps;
            ELSE
                rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps := rDVL_Surge_Vel_ChC_mps;
            END_IF;
            wSensorHealthMatrix := wSensorHealthMatrix OR 16#0008; (* Critical Discrepancy *)
        END_IF;

        (* Sway Velocity 2oo3 Voting *)
        rDiff_AB := ABS(rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChA_mps - rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChB_mps);
        rDiff_BC := ABS(rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChB_mps - rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChC_mps);
        IF (rDiff_AB <= 0.18) THEN
            rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChA_mps + rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
        ELSIF (rDiff_BC <= 0.18) THEN
            rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChB_mps + rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChC_mps) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChA_mps + rDVL_Sway_Vel_ChC_mps) * 0.5;
        END_IF;

        (* Heave Velocity 2oo3 Voting *)
        rDiff_AB := ABS(rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChA_mps - rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChB_mps);
        IF (rDiff_AB <= 0.22) THEN
            rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps := (rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChA_mps + rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps := rDVL_Heave_Vel_ChC_mps;
        END_IF;

        (* Depth Sensor 2oo3 Voting *)
        rDiff_AB := ABS(rDepth_Sensor_ChA_m - rDepth_Sensor_ChB_m);
        rDiff_BC := ABS(rDepth_Sensor_ChB_m - rDepth_Sensor_ChC_m);
        IF (rDiff_AB <= 0.30) THEN
            rVoted_Depth_m := (rDepth_Sensor_ChA_m + rDepth_Sensor_ChB_m) * 0.5;
        ELSIF (rDiff_BC <= 0.30) THEN
            rVoted_Depth_m := (rDepth_Sensor_ChB_m + rDepth_Sensor_ChC_m) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rVoted_Depth_m := (rDepth_Sensor_ChA_m + rDepth_Sensor_ChC_m) * 0.5;
        END_IF;

        (* Attitude Rates & Heading Averaging *)
        rVoted_RollRate_rads  := (rINS_RollRate_ChA_rads + rINS_RollRate_ChB_rads + rINS_RollRate_ChC_rads) / 3.0;
        rVoted_PitchRate_rads := (rINS_PitchRate_ChA_rads + rINS_PitchRate_ChB_rads + rINS_PitchRate_ChC_rads) / 3.0;
        rVoted_YawRate_rads   := (rINS_YawRate_ChA_rads + rINS_YawRate_ChB_rads + rINS_YawRate_ChC_rads) / 3.0;
        rVoted_Heading_deg    := (rINS_Heading_ChA_deg + rINS_Heading_ChB_deg + rINS_Heading_ChC_deg) / 3.0;

        (* Dead-Reckoning Position Integrator *)
        rEstimatedPos_Surge_m := rEstimatedPos_Surge_m + (rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps * rCycleTime_s);
        rEstimatedPos_Sway_m  := rEstimatedPos_Sway_m  + (rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps * rCycleTime_s);

        (* --- SUB-PHASE 2: NONLINEAR DISTURBANCE OBSERVER (NDOB) --- *)
        (* Surge Disturbance Dynamics *)
        rInternalHydroForce := -(rDampLin_Surge * rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps + 
                                 rDampQuad_Surge * ABS(rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps) * rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps);
        rDOB_State_z_Surge  := rDOB_State_z_Surge + rCycleTime_s * (
            -rDOB_Gain_Surge * rDOB_State_z_Surge
            - rDOB_Gain_Surge * (rInternalHydroForce + rDemandedWrench_X_N - rDOB_Gain_Surge * (rMassTotal_kg + rAddedMass_X_kg) * rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps)
        );
        rEstDisturbance_Surge_N := rDOB_State_z_Surge + rDOB_Gain_Surge * (rMassTotal_kg + rAddedMass_X_kg) * rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps;

        (* Sway Disturbance Dynamics *)
        rInternalHydroForce := -(rDampLin_Sway * rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps + 
                                 rDampQuad_Sway * ABS(rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps) * rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps);
        rDOB_State_z_Sway   := rDOB_State_z_Sway + rCycleTime_s * (
            -rDOB_Gain_Sway * rDOB_State_z_Sway
            - rDOB_Gain_Sway * (rInternalHydroForce + rDemandedWrench_Y_N - rDOB_Gain_Sway * (rMassTotal_kg + rAddedMass_Y_kg) * rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps)
        );
        rEstDisturbance_Sway_N := rDOB_State_z_Sway + rDOB_Gain_Sway * (rMassTotal_kg + rAddedMass_Y_kg) * rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps;

        (* Heave Disturbance Dynamics (Current Upwelling & Umbilical Weight Drag) *)
        rInternalHydroForce := -(rDampLin_Heave * rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps + 
                                 rDampQuad_Heave * ABS(rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps) * rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps);
        rDOB_State_z_Heave  := rDOB_State_z_Heave + rCycleTime_s * (
            -rDOB_Gain_Heave * rDOB_State_z_Heave
            - rDOB_Gain_Heave * (rInternalHydroForce + rDemandedWrench_Z_N - rDOB_Gain_Heave * (rMassTotal_kg + rAddedMass_Z_kg) * rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps)
        );
        rEstDisturbance_Heave_N := rDOB_State_z_Heave + rDOB_Gain_Heave * (rMassTotal_kg + rAddedMass_Z_kg) * rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps;

        (* Yaw Moment Disturbance Dynamics *)
        rInternalHydroForce := -(rDampLin_Yaw * rVoted_YawRate_rads + 
                                 rDampQuad_Yaw * ABS(rVoted_YawRate_rads) * rVoted_YawRate_rads);
        rDOB_State_z_Yaw    := rDOB_State_z_Yaw + rCycleTime_s * (
            -rDOB_Gain_Yaw * rDOB_State_z_Yaw
            - rDOB_Gain_Yaw * (rInternalHydroForce + rDemandedTorque_N_Nm - rDOB_Gain_Yaw * rInertia_Z_kgm2 * rVoted_YawRate_rads)
        );
        rEstDisturbance_Yaw_Nm := rDOB_State_z_Yaw + rDOB_Gain_Yaw * rInertia_Z_kgm2 * rVoted_YawRate_rads;

        (* Ocean Current Speed Estimation *)
        rEstOceanCurrentVel_mps := SQRT((ABS(rEstDisturbance_Surge_N) + ABS(rEstDisturbance_Sway_N)) / 
                                        (rDampQuad_Surge + rDampQuad_Sway + 0.001));

        (* --- SUB-PHASE 3: CLOSED-LOOP 6-DOF CONTROL LAW COMPUTATION --- *)
        rErr_Surge_m := rRef_Surge_Pos_m - rEstimatedPos_Surge_m;
        rErr_Sway_m  := rRef_Sway_Pos_m  - rEstimatedPos_Sway_m;
        rErr_Depth_m := rRef_Depth_Pos_m - rVoted_Depth_m;

        rErr_Heading_deg := rRef_Heading_deg - rVoted_Heading_deg;
        IF rErr_Heading_deg > 180.0 THEN
            rErr_Heading_deg := rErr_Heading_deg - 360.0;
        ELSIF rErr_Heading_deg < -180.0 THEN
            rErr_Heading_deg := rErr_Heading_deg + 360.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Anti-Windup Numerical Integrators *)
        rInteg_Surge_Ns := LIMIT(-15000.0, rInteg_Surge_Ns + (rErr_Surge_m * rCycleTime_s), 15000.0);
        rInteg_Sway_Ns  := LIMIT(-15000.0, rInteg_Sway_Ns  + (rErr_Sway_m  * rCycleTime_s), 15000.0);
        rInteg_Depth_Ns := LIMIT(-20000.0, rInteg_Depth_Ns + (rErr_Depth_m * rCycleTime_s), 20000.0);
        rInteg_Yaw_Nms  := LIMIT(-10000.0, rInteg_Yaw_Nms  + ((rErr_Heading_deg * 3.141592 / 180.0) * rCycleTime_s), 10000.0);

        (* 6-DOF Demanded Force and Moment Synthesis *)
        rDemandedWrench_X_N  := (rKp_Surge * rErr_Surge_m) + (rKi_Surge * rInteg_Surge_Ns) - (rKd_Surge * rVoted_Surge_Vel_mps) - rEstDisturbance_Surge_N;
        rDemandedWrench_Y_N  := (rKp_Sway  * rErr_Sway_m)  + (rKi_Sway  * rInteg_Sway_Ns)  - (rKd_Sway  * rVoted_Sway_Vel_mps)  - rEstDisturbance_Sway_N;
        rDemandedWrench_Z_N  := (rKp_Depth * rErr_Depth_m) + (rKi_Depth * rInteg_Depth_Ns) - (rKd_Depth * rVoted_Heave_Vel_mps) - rEstDisturbance_Heave_N;
        rDemandedTorque_N_Nm := (rKp_Yaw   * (rErr_Heading_deg * 3.141592 / 180.0)) + (rKi_Yaw * rInteg_Yaw_Nms) - (rKd_Yaw * rVoted_YawRate_rads) - rEstDisturbance_Yaw_Nm;

        (* Metacentric Damping for Roll and Pitch Angles *)
        rDemandedTorque_K_Nm := -1350.0 * rVoted_RollRate_rads;
        rDemandedTorque_M_Nm := -1550.0 * rVoted_PitchRate_rads;

        (* --- SUB-PHASE 4: 8-THRUSTER PSEUDO-INVERSE ALLOCATION MATRIX --- *)
        (* Horizontal Subsystem: 4 Vectored Thrusters at 45 deg angles *)
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[1] := ( 0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_X_N) - (0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_Y_N) - (0.2631 * rDemandedTorque_N_Nm);
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[2] := ( 0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_X_N) + (0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_Y_N) + (0.2631 * rDemandedTorque_N_Nm);
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[3] := (-0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_X_N) + (0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_Y_N) - (0.2631 * rDemandedTorque_N_Nm);
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[4] := (-0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_X_N) - (0.3535 * rDemandedWrench_Y_N) + (0.2631 * rDemandedTorque_N_Nm);

        (* Vertical Subsystem: 4 Canted Thrusters (canted 15 deg for roll/pitch righting) *)
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[5] := (0.2588 * rDemandedWrench_Z_N) + (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_K_Nm) + (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_M_Nm);
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[6] := (0.2588 * rDemandedWrench_Z_N) - (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_K_Nm) + (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_M_Nm);
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[7] := (0.2588 * rDemandedWrench_Z_N) - (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_K_Nm) - (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_M_Nm);
        arrUnboundedThrust_N[8] := (0.2588 * rDemandedWrench_Z_N) + (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_K_Nm) - (0.2941 * rDemandedTorque_M_Nm);

        (* Check for Thruster Faults in Bitmask *)
        iHealthyCount := 0;
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            IF (SHR(wThrusterHealthRegister, (iIdx - 1)) AND 16#0001) <> 0 THEN
                iHealthyCount := iHealthyCount + 1;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        IF iHealthyCount < 8 THEN
            (* Transition into Degraded Allocation Mode *)
            iOperatingMode := 30;
        END_IF;

        (* --- SUB-PHASE 5: POWER ATTENUATION & SLEW RATE LIMITING --- *)
        rCurrentPowerSum_kW     := 0.0;
        bThrustSaturationActive := FALSE;

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            rCurrentPowerSum_kW := rCurrentPowerSum_kW + 
                                   (rPowerConversionConstant * EXPT(ABS(arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx]), 1.5) / 1000.0);
        END_FOR;
        rAggregatedPower_kW := rCurrentPowerSum_kW;

        IF rAggregatedPower_kW > rMaxBusPowerAvailable_kW THEN
            rPowerAttenuationRatio  := rMaxBusPowerAvailable_kW / (rAggregatedPower_kW + 0.001);
            bThrustSaturationActive := TRUE;
        ELSE
            rPowerAttenuationRatio := 1.0;
        END_IF;

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx] * rPowerAttenuationRatio;

            (* Absolute Rating Clamp *)
            IF ABS(arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx]) > rBollardThrustRating_N THEN
                arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := LIMIT(-rBollardThrustRating_N, arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx], rBollardThrustRating_N);
                bThrustSaturationActive := TRUE;
            END_IF;

            (* Actuator Dynamic Slew Rate Limiter *)
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := LIMIT(
                arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] - (rSlewLimit_Nps * rCycleTime_s),
                arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx],
                arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] + (rSlewLimit_Nps * rCycleTime_s)
            );
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx];
        END_FOR;

        (* Copy Conditioned Forces to Actuator Outputs *)
        rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := arrConditionedThrust_N[1];
        rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH := arrConditionedThrust_N[2];
        rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH := arrConditionedThrust_N[3];
        rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH := arrConditionedThrust_N[4];
        rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV := arrConditionedThrust_N[5];
        rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV := arrConditionedThrust_N[6];
        rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV := arrConditionedThrust_N[7];
        rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV := arrConditionedThrust_N[8];

        bSystemOperational := TRUE;
        bDegradedOperation := FALSE;

        IF NOT bEnableMasterDP THEN
            iOperatingMode := 10; (* Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* =========================================================================
           STATE 30: DEGRADED DP-3 RECONFIGURED THRUSTER ALLOCATION
           ========================================================================= *)
        wMasterStatusWord  := 16#0030; (* Degraded Reconfigured Mode Active *)
        bDegradedOperation := TRUE;
        bSystemOperational := TRUE;

        (* Zero out offline thrusters and redistribute load to complementary pairs *)
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            IF (SHR(wThrusterHealthRegister, (iIdx - 1)) AND 16#0001) = 0 THEN
                arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;

                (* Horizontal Paired Reallocation *)
                IF iIdx = 1 THEN
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[2] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[2] * 1.48;
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[4] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[4] * 1.48;
                ELSIF iIdx = 2 THEN
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[1] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[1] * 1.48;
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[3] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[3] * 1.48;
                ELSIF iIdx = 3 THEN
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[2] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[2] * 1.48;
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[4] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[4] * 1.48;
                ELSIF iIdx = 4 THEN
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[1] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[1] * 1.48;
                    arrUnboundedThrust_N[3] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[3] * 1.48;
                END_IF;

                (* Vertical Group Reallocation *)
                IF (iIdx >= 5) AND (iIdx <= 8) THEN
                    FOR iVertLoop := 5 TO 8 DO
                        IF iVertLoop <> iIdx THEN
                            arrUnboundedThrust_N[iVertLoop] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[iVertLoop] * 1.333;
                        END_IF;
                    END_FOR;
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        (* Perform Power Limiting and Slew Limiting on Reallocated Commands *)
        rCurrentPowerSum_kW := 0.0;
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            rCurrentPowerSum_kW := rCurrentPowerSum_kW + 
                                   (rPowerConversionConstant * EXPT(ABS(arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx]), 1.5) / 1000.0);
        END_FOR;
        rAggregatedPower_kW := rCurrentPowerSum_kW;

        IF rAggregatedPower_kW > rMaxBusPowerAvailable_kW THEN
            rPowerAttenuationRatio  := rMaxBusPowerAvailable_kW / (rAggregatedPower_kW + 0.001);
            bThrustSaturationActive := TRUE;
        ELSE
            rPowerAttenuationRatio := 1.0;
        END_IF;

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := arrUnboundedThrust_N[iIdx] * rPowerAttenuationRatio;
            IF ABS(arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx]) > rBollardThrustRating_N THEN
                arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := LIMIT(-rBollardThrustRating_N, arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx], rBollardThrustRating_N);
                bThrustSaturationActive := TRUE;
            END_IF;
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := LIMIT(
                arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] - (rSlewLimit_Nps * rCycleTime_s),
                arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx],
                arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] + (rSlewLimit_Nps * rCycleTime_s)
            );
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx];
        END_FOR;

        rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := arrConditionedThrust_N[1];
        rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH := arrConditionedThrust_N[2];
        rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH := arrConditionedThrust_N[3];
        rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH := arrConditionedThrust_N[4];
        rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV := arrConditionedThrust_N[5];
        rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV := arrConditionedThrust_N[6];
        rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV := arrConditionedThrust_N[7];
        rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV := arrConditionedThrust_N[8];

        (* Check if All Thrusters Restored *)
        IF iHealthyCount = 8 THEN
            iOperatingMode := 20; (* Return to Standard DP-3 *)
        ELSIF iHealthyCount <= 3 THEN
            (* Too many thrusters lost: Inadequate control authority for 6-DOF *)
            iOperatingMode := 99; (* Critical Failsafe Trip *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* =========================================================================
           STATE 99: CRITICAL FAILSAFE LOCKOUT
           ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemOperational    := FALSE;
        bSafetyTripActive     := TRUE;
        wMasterStatusWord     := 16#FFFF; (* Emergency Trip Active *)

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            arrConditionedThrust_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPreviousThrustCmd_N[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;

        rThrusterCmd_T1_FwdStbdH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T2_FwdPortH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T3_AftPortH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T4_AftStbdH := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T5_FwdStbdV := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T6_FwdPortV := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T7_AftPortV := 0.0;
        rThrusterCmd_T8_AftStbdV := 0.0;

        IF bEmergencyStopCircuit AND bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
            iOperatingMode := 0; (* Reset Trip: Re-initialize System *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
